items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Art D’lugoff would have fresh orange juice back there for me.

ctx.x: And we got oranges out there, so Art D’lugoff would have fresh orange juice back there for me. Well one night I went in and I taste the orange juice, we traded sets with Monk, and the orange juice was tainted, spoiled. I noticed it every that every night Monk would be drinking my orange juice every night. So said to Niko who was back stage, I said, “Niko when Thelonious gets here, tell him don't drink this orange juice cause it's tainted. "Oh thank you Charles! Thank you! Thank you!" and so Monk comes in dancing…

tainted!" and he didn't pay him no mind, he just kept dancing and we got over to the pitcher of orange juice. He took it over by me, and got right in my face this close and said "Gooroooorooooo" [drinking impersonation] Newton:[Laughs]
